title: Same-day latest-run pointer
description: A latest_*.json convenience pointer (latest_morning_run.json, latest_midday_run.json, latest_scheduled_run.json, and the monitor/slippage/watchdog equivalents) written after each scheduled run. A pointer is trusted as same-day scheduled evidence ONLY when trading_day and run_state_path match the current America/New_York date and the expected stream directory. See config/scheduled_tasks.json -> same_day_pointer_validation_policy and scripts/same_day_pointer.py. Recording this metadata does NOT relax any trading safety rule.

run_id.description: Run identifier of the target run_state, e.g. morning_live_YYYYMMDD_1030ET or scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET.

run_state_path.description: Absolute path to the target run_state.json. Must resolve inside the expected stream root; an outside-root path is ignored.

stream.description: Logical stream the pointer belongs to.

trading_day.description: America/New_York trading day (YYYY-MM-DD) the target run belongs to. Must equal the current ET day to be same-day evidence.

pointer_status.description: Lifecycle status. Only 'valid' is trusted; the rest are ignored as scheduled evidence.

same_day_required.description: Always true: the pointer is same-day scoped and must match the current ET trading day.

valid_scheduled_evidence.description: Derived from the target run_state, never asserted blindly: true only when the target exists and has run_origin='scheduled' and manual_run=false. A pending placeholder is false until the target run_state is finalized.

updated_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the pointer was last refreshed.

cron_id.description: Optional scheduler cron/task id of the target run.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Optional superseded cron id for lineage continuity.

triggered_at_utc.description: Optional trigger timestamp copied from the target run_classification.

state_schema_version.description: Optional run_state schema version of the target.
